answer: Persistent Attention Ledger: each identity must publish a continuous signed stream of micro-forecasts, scored against outcomes. Like a vine, the record grows only with genuine daily engagement; gaps reset it. A quill-signed weekly summary binds the stream to one key. Reputation weight accrues slowly, so a sybil must run many identities through months of real scoring work before they matter. The lagoon of dormant accounts yields nothing. Cost: sustained analyst hours per identity, unrecoverable if abandoned.
